title.en: Kokoro ga Yomeru Oujo wa Konyakusha no Dekiai ni Kizukanai
Shiitagerareta Tsuihou Oujo wa, Tensei shita Densetsu no Majo deshita ~Mukae ni Koraretemo Komarumasu. Juuboku to no Ohirune wo Jamashinaide Kudasai~
Imouto ni Konyakusha wo Toraretara Mishiranu Koushaku-sama ni Kyuukonsaremashita
Ouji, Konyaku Haki Shita no wa Sochira na no de, Kowai Kao de Kocchi Niramanaide kudasai
In My Previous Life, I Was A Saint, But Now I Want To Cut Corners
Kakure Saijo wa Zenzen Megenai: Gibo to Gimai ni Ie o Oidasareta no de Kon'yaku Haki shite Moraou to Omottara, Shinshi Datta Kon'yakusha ga Hageshiku Dekiai shite kuru you ni narimashita!?
Reikoku Koutei wa Hitojichi Oujo wo Dekiai-chuu
Konyakusha no Uwaki Genba wo Michatta no de Hajimari no Kane ga Narimashita
Kakan no Oukoku no Hanagirai Hime
Imokusa Reijou desu ga Akuyaku Reisoku wo Tasuketara Kiniiraremashita
Higeki no Heroine Buru Imouto no Sei de Konyaku Hakishita no desu ga, Naze ka Seigikan no Tsuyoi Outaishi ni Karamareru you ni narimashita
Kon'yaku Haki o Neratte Kioku Soushitsu no Furi o Shitara, Sokkenai Taido datta Kon'yakusha ga "Kioku o Ushinau Mae no Kimi wa, Ore ni Betabore datta" to Iu, Tondemonai Uso o Tsuki Hajimeta
Ohitorisama ni wa Naremashita no de. Konyakusha Houchi-chuu!
Risu ni Natte Shimatta Konyakusha ga, Kegirai shiteita Hazu no Watashi ni Tasuke wo Motomete Kimashita.
